title: Structured AI Named to BuiltWorlds 40 AI-Driven AEC Solutions to Watch in 2026
summary: Structured AI has been recognized by BuiltWorlds as one of the 40 AI-driven AEC solutions to watch in 2026 for its AI agents that review engineering drawings in minutes instead of weeks.
body_markdown:
We're named to BuiltWorlds' 40 AI-Driven AEC Solutions to Watch in 2026 and we're proud to be in that company.


Of the 40 on the list, we're the only ones doing compliance checking on engineering drawings, scanning every sheet against building codes and firm standards, returning a flagged list with exact location and a recommended fix, in under 20 minutes. Most of the list works the execution layer: project management, takeoffs, reality capture, site logistics. Structured AI catches the errors before any of that begins.
